title: BGW Circuit Reconstruction
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $A$ be a finite set of nonzero field elements with $2d+1\le |A|$, and suppose each input wire $i$ is supplied with shares that are evaluations of a polynomial of degree at most $d$ whose value at $0$ is $v(i)$. For every arithmetic circuit $C$, recombining the shares produced by the BGW evaluation of $C$ on these inputs yields $C$ evaluated at the secret inputs $v$.
